_what: Frozen values for the singularity-entry definition (docs/singularity-entry-definition.md). scripts/site.py scores the gauges from this file. Changing any value is an amendment entry in docs/amendments.md.

leg_a.anchor: METR 50% task-completion time horizon (Time Horizon 1.1), frontier models only (METR's is_sota flag)
leg_a.reference_source: metr-th11-doubling-all: METR's own fit over all frontier models 2019 to early 2026. The trailing-window series cannot be computed in 2019 itself (one reading), so the longest fit anchored at the reference year stands in. Agent decision, 2026-10-08.
leg_a.successor_rule: When the anchor stops moving (saturates), a replacement measure is named before that happens, the overlap period is published, and the switch is an amendment.

leg_b.measure: forecast horizon H(t): the longest lead at which forecasts of the anchor still beat trend extrapolation
leg_b.status: not yet measurable: the forecast-versus-outcome ledger is not built, so H(t) and the reference horizon do not exist. The stand-in (excess pull-in of the consensus date) is reported beside the gauge and never substituted for it.

leg_c.measure: share of the work that produces frontier AI progress that is supplied by AI systems
leg_c.rows: the latest anthropic_institute-*-rd-leads row (self-report, one company; the Google code-share row is a proxy and is not scored)

leg_d.measure: doubling time of world output, from annual world real GDP growth (World Bank)
leg_d.threshold_source: Davidson 2021, 'explosive growth' is more than 30 percent a year (search world_bank-davidson-001)
leg_d.reference: mean world growth 1961 to the reference year 2019, from the same series
